findings.body: The survival assertion checks only the unrelated Python sleeper created on line 74. That process neither represents Codex nor holds the resumed conversation, so code that selectively terminates the competing Codex writer could still pass this test. The stub returns the active-writer error without any corresponding holder. Add command-level coverage with a separate simulated Codex holder and verify that it survives both retry recovery and fresh-start fallback. Item 3 explicitly requires this protection.
